subject.title: test(ai): freeze packed-package and stream parity contracts

question: Should standalone `@openclaw/ai` consumers change from identity transcript handling to package-owned normalization by default in this release line?
rationale: The code intentionally changes a published package’s unconfigured runtime behavior, and the supplied evidence does not establish that all existing consumers may safely receive transformed transcripts.

options.title: Preserve the existing default
options.body: Keep identity handling for unconfigured consumers and invoke package normalization only through an explicit package or host contract.

options.title: Accept the package behavior change
options.body: Approve normalization as the new standalone default with clear upgrade documentation, semver/release treatment, and packed-consumer proof for both host modes.

recommendation.title: Preserve the existing default
recommendation.body: Keep identity handling for unconfigured consumers and invoke package normalization only through an explicit package or host contract.
